title: [review] router.rs:32: Unchecked extreme trickle inte
description: When dio_int_min is large (e.g., 30-31), the computed imin_ms can be ~12-24 days (1<<30 = 1073741824 ms). The function validates dio_int_min >= 32 returns None via the checked_shl overflow, but values 30-31 produce valid but extreme intervals that may cause Trickle timer malfunction or unexpected behavior. No upper bound validation exists.
